title: Pointwise underlying-map comparison for quotient chart overlaps
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $L$ an invertible $X$-module [def-sc-invertible-module], and $S$ its graded section ring [def-sc-invertible-section-ring]. Let $d,e>0$, $s\in S_d$, $t\in S_e$, and opens $U,V\subseteq X$ with underlying sets respectively the nonvanishing loci of $s,t$ [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. Suppose given morphisms $g:U\to\operatorname{Proj}(S)$ and $h:V\to\operatorname{Proj}(S)$ [def-pc-proj]. For each of these morphisms $k$, assume that for every positive-degree homogeneous $a\in S_r$, every $n\geq0$, and every $\xi\in S_{nr}$, on the ambient image $W$ of $k^{-1}(D_+(a))$ its scalar pullback satisfies $k^\sharp(\xi/a^n)\cdot(a^n)|_W=\xi|_W$. Then the underlying continuous maps of $g|_{U\cap V}$ and $h|_{U\cap V}$ are equal.

source.place: Tags 01N8 (lemma-converse-construction), local quotient construction and uniqueness; 01NK (lemma-invertible-map-into-proj), differing degrees

proof.text: Import all Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.SectionRingProjPreimageForward and reuse its proved private helper nonvanishing_power, which identifies the nonvanishing locus of each positive homogeneous power with that of its base. Its tensor/isomorphism/component helpers are not redeclared here.

For one chart map g on U and a point x of U with a nonvanishing section s of positive degree d, prove the membership equivalence for any a of positive degree r. In the forward direction specialize hg to denominator a, exponent d and numerator s^r, using r*d=d*r. Take ambient germs at x on the image of the inverse-image chart. If a^d vanished modulo the maximal ideal, its scalar multiple s^r would vanish too. The positive-power test gives nonvanishing of a. Reuse nonvanishing_power and nonvanishing_of_local_smul from SectionRingProjPreimageForward, accessed by the proof-only import all; these helpers retain the ambient scheme X and apply directly to the image open.

For the reverse direction choose a positive homogeneous b of degree q outside the image prime, using avoidance of the irrelevant ideal. Apply hg to denominator b, exponent r and numerator a^q. Taking ambient germs, nonvanishing of a^q forces the pulled-back scalar germ to be a unit. Map this unit through U.stalkIso.inv and use U.germ_stalkIso_inv. Localness of g.stalkMap reflects it to the Proj stalk. ProjectiveSpectrum.Proj.awayToSection_germ and Proj.stalkIso identify this germ with the homogeneous fraction. HomogeneousLocalization.isUnit_iff_isUnit_val and IsLocalization.AtPrime.isUnit_mk'_iff show its numerator a^q avoids the homogeneous prime. Proj.basicOpen_pow gives membership in D_+(a). Reuse exists_sectionRing_chart, scalar_isUnit_of_nonvanishing and chart_fraction_numerator_notMem from SectionRingProjPreimageReverse, and nonvanishing_power from SectionRingProjPreimageForward, through proof-only import all. Only the open-immersion germ transport is proved locally.

The two images of an overlap point have identical membership in every positive homogeneous basic open by applying the single-chart equivalence on U and V, whose underlying source points agree by Scheme.homOfLE_apply. Compare the homogeneous prime ideals with HomogeneousIdeal.ext'. Positive-degree membership already agrees. For degree zero choose a positive homogeneous b outside the first prime; it is outside the second too. Apply the positive-degree comparison to a*b, and use Proj.basicOpen_mul to cancel membership in D_+(b). Equality of homogeneous prime ideals gives equality of Proj points by ProjectiveSpectrum.ext. This avoids constructing a positive-degree topological basis. The common positive homogeneous chart is supplied by the existing private exists_sectionRing_chart helper in SectionRingProjPreimageReverse.

proof_origin.place: Tags 01N8 and 01NK, uniqueness by homogeneous chart membership. D2 repair reuses the proved private helpers of SectionRingProjPreimageForward and SectionRingProjPreimageReverse with proof-only import all, rather than duplicating their statements and proofs. The local open-immersion scalar-germ transport and final homogeneous-ideal extensionality are proved by D2.

theorem sectionRing_overlap_base_map_pointwise
    (X : Scheme.{v}) (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (d e : ℕ) (s : sectionRingGrade L d) (t : sectionRingGrade L e)
    (hd : 0 < d) (he : 0 < e) (U V : X.Opens)
    (hU : (U : Set X) = nonvanishingLocus (L.tensorPow d) (s.val d))
    (hV : (V : Set X) = nonvanishingLocus (L.tensorPow e) (t.val e))
    (g : U.toScheme ⟶ Proj (sectionRingGrade L))
    (h : V.toScheme ⟶ Proj (sectionRingGrade L))
    (hg : ∀ (e : ℕ) (_he : 0 < e) (t : sectionRingGrade L e)
          (n : ℕ) (ξ : sectionRingGrade L (n • e)),
          (show Γ(X, U.ι ''ᵁ (g ⁻¹ᵁ
              Proj.basicOpen (sectionRingGrade L) t.val)) from
            g.app (Proj.basicOpen (sectionRingGrade L) t.val)
            (Proj.awayToSection (sectionRingGrade L) t.val
              (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (sectionRingGrade L) t.property n
                ξ.val ξ.property))) •
            (L.tensorPow (n • e)).presheaf.map (homOfLE
              (le_top : U.ι ''ᵁ (g ⁻¹ᵁ Proj.basicOpen (sectionRingGrade L) t.val) ≤
                ⊤)).op ((t.val ^ n) (n • e)) =
          (L.tensorPow (n • e)).presheaf.map (homOfLE
            (le_top : U.ι ''ᵁ (g ⁻¹ᵁ Proj.basicOpen (sectionRingGrade L) t.val) ≤
              ⊤)).op (ξ.val (n • e)))
    (hh : ∀ (e : ℕ) (_he : 0 < e) (t : sectionRingGrade L e)
          (n : ℕ) (ξ : sectionRingGrade L (n • e)),
          (show Γ(X, V.ι ''ᵁ (h ⁻¹ᵁ
              Proj.basicOpen (sectionRingGrade L) t.val)) from
            h.app (Proj.basicOpen (sectionRingGrade L) t.val)
            (Proj.awayToSection (sectionRingGrade L) t.val
              (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (sectionRingGrade L) t.property n
                ξ.val ξ.property))) •
            (L.tensorPow (n • e)).presheaf.map (homOfLE
              (le_top : V.ι ''ᵁ (h ⁻¹ᵁ Proj.basicOpen (sectionRingGrade L) t.val) ≤
                ⊤)).op ((t.val ^ n) (n • e)) =
          (L.tensorPow (n • e)).presheaf.map (homOfLE
            (le_top : V.ι ''ᵁ (h ⁻¹ᵁ Proj.basicOpen (sectionRingGrade L) t.val) ≤
              ⊤)).op (ξ.val (n • e))) :
    ∀ x, (ConcreteCategory.hom (X.homOfLE (inf_le_left : U ⊓ V ≤ U) ≫ g).base) x =
      (ConcreteCategory.hom (X.homOfLE (inf_le_right : U ⊓ V ≤ V) ≫ h).base) x
